name: Gemini attitude hand controller
view: the attitude hand controller from behind, as the crew sees it on the console between the two seats: the pistol grip on its housing, usable by either pilot; moved fore / aft for pitch, side to side for roll and twisted for yaw
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the grip and housing reconstructed from the public Gemini spacecraft descriptions (NASA Gemini familiarization manual overview, Smithsonian museum descriptions, Wikipedia) and public museum photos looked at for proportions; not traced from a photo.
